claim: cppcheck uninitvar "Uninitialized variable: od->output" at gfx/common/wayland_common.c:292 and :1066
rationale: FP — cppcheck can't see that the wl_list_for_each container_of macro initializes the iterator `od` each pass. At :292 the empty-list case is already guarded by `if (!oi) return;` at :299 (the Bundle-fixed MEDIUM item, commit 71fa88edb0). At :1066 `oi`/`od->output` is only read inside the matched loop body. Not a bug; wl_list_for_each macro blind-spot class.

FP — dispmanx_get_free_page() wraps the page search in `while (!page)` (line 136), so the loop only exits once `page` is non-NULL; the deref of page->page_used_mutex at :160 is guaranteed safe. The inner `if (!page)` at :150 is load-bearing loop control (triggers the vsync wait), not dead code. Reported by the Bundle 89 gfx/ sweep.
